name: ai-self-media-video-packaging-skill
description: An Agent Skill for packaging talking-head videos with Remotion, HyperFrames, evidence cards, and programmatic line illustrations.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && remotion compositions packages/remotion-renderer/src/index.ts
scripts.example:synthetic: tsx scripts/package-video.ts --video examples/synthetic-horizontal/input.mp4 --srt examples/synthetic-horizontal/input.srt --out examples/synthetic-horizontal/run --renderer remotion --approve-gate-a --render
scripts.verify:all: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run verify:public
